blocks.h2: Why Faucets Wear Faster With Hard Water
blocks.body: At around 8 grains per gallon, Elmhurst's water leaves mineral deposits in aerators, cartridges and spray heads. Over time, a faucet gets stiff, drips or sprays unevenly. Cleaning the aerator helps. Replacing a worn cartridge fixes most drips. If your fixtures are wearing out often, a softener can protect them along with your water heater and dishwasher.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Faucet Work
blocks.body: A simple cartridge swap is a short visit. Replacing a faucet takes longer, especially if the old one is corroded in place or the shutoffs need replacing. Kitchen faucets with sprayers, filters or touchless sensors add a few steps. We look at the faucet, the sink and the valves underneath, then give you one flat price.

items.q: Why is my faucet spray weak and uneven?
items.answer: Usually mineral scale in the aerator or sprayer. Cleaning or replacing it fixes it.

items.q: Can you install a faucet I bought?
items.answer: Yes, as long as it's complete and suits the sink.

items.q: Should I replace the shutoff valves?
items.preview: If they're old or stiff, yes.
items.answer: If they're original or hard to turn, yes, while the faucet is off.

items.q: Will a softener help my fixtures?
items.answer: It reduces scale buildup on faucets and in cartridges. See [water softeners](/elmhurst/water-filtration-systems).

items.q: How long should a kitchen faucet last?
items.answer: A good faucet often lasts 10 to 15 years, longer with replacement parts.

items.q: Can you install a pot filler?
items.answer: Yes. It needs a cold supply line run to the wall behind the range.

items.q: How much does faucet repair cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
